sentences.text:
Section 4 Of The Dowry Prohibition Act vs In Re: Abdul Kalam
Khan on 7 October, 2024
Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen 07.10.2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code  Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik  Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Nandigram Police Station Case No  700 of 2024 dated 16.08.2024 corresponding to G.R Case No. 1926 of 2024  under Sections 498A/406/376E/506/509/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
 And  In Re: Abdul Kalam Khan  Petitioner  Mr. Aniket Mitra For the Petitioner  Mr. Shiladitya Banerjee  Mr. Mainak Gupta For the State  Mr. Madhu Jana  Mr. Golam Zaky For the De-facto Complainant  1.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence and also having regard to the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C disclosing physical and mental cruelty upon the de- facto complainant, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

3. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected and the same is accordingly disposed of.
4.
All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
